newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTOKUMPU IN FIM 106 MLN TECHNOLOGY DEAL.
newsitem.headline: OUTOKUMPU IN FIM 106 MLN TECHNOLOGY DEAL.

text.p: Finnish mining and metal group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it won an order worth 106 million markka to supply ferrochrome technology to Samancor in South Africa.

Outoumpu Engineering Contractors Oy would supply technology, engineering design and certain proprietary equipment for a project involving the construction of a 520,000 tonnes per year pelletising and steel belt sintering plant.
Samancor's Ferrometals ferrocrome plant, located at Witbank in Mpumulanga province, is scheduled to be completed towards the end of 1997, Outokumpu said.
